title: Wardrobes
status: Draft – no wardrobe ITP in QA Records Task; confirm the right ITP
itp: No wardrobe ITP found – based on kitchen & joinery ITPs

questions.q: Pattressing in and photographed before boarding, positions matching the wardrobe elevation?
questions.source: Kitchen/joinery ITPs – fixing; Block 5 snags & lessons (SJWS)

questions.q: Access panels behind the units fire-taped and photographed before the unit panel goes on?
questions.source: Block 5 snags & lessons (SJWS) – "only after the wall access panel has been fire taped"

questions.q: Ask the fitter: What gaps are you working to – door to door, and to the wall and ceiling? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't give the figure is working without the detail

questions.q: Carcasses level, plumb and fixed into pattresses – no exposed or wrong-colour screws?
questions.source: Kitchen/joinery ITPs – fixing; Block 5 snags & lessons (SJWS)

questions.q: Door and drawer gaps equal all round; fronts flush with the cheeks and each other, no proud corners?
questions.source: Kitchen/joinery ITPs – doors; Block 5 snags & lessons (SJWS) (gaps/alignment ~70 snags)

guide.title: Wardrobes – what correct looks like (Block 5)
rows: equal and consistent – no wider at one end
flush with cheeks and each other
tight to wall, ceiling and floor – nothing visible behind
guide.note: No wardrobe ITP or installer tolerance on file. Ask the fitter for the figure; if they can't give it, raise it. QualityBot holds the EES/Molteni tech sub.

questions.q: Scribed tight to walls, ceiling and floor – no visible gaps, no white MDF showing; soffit and blind-box panels flush?
Doors and drawers open and close fully, soft-close working, nothing bouncing back or rubbing?
Every shelf, rail and drawer fitted and fixed; spare shelf holes and screw caps plugged?
questions.source: Block 5 snags & lessons (SJWS) – "plug spare shelf holes, fix every shelf and front"

questions.q: Edges and arrises clean – no chips, fraying laminate, bubbles or filler showing?
Handles, hooks, rails and lighting fitted, secure and working; cables hidden?
Packers removed, units cleaned out (including underneath), no paint on the joinery, protected?

notOk.t: Chips, scratches and dents on panels, shelves and arrises
Poor edge finish – fraying laminate, bubbles, filler showing, repairs not one-piece veneer
Gaps to wall, ceiling or between units – white MDF or what's behind showing
Fronts not flush with cheeks; vertical gaps not equal
Shelves, drawers or back panels not fitted; spare shelf holes unplugged
Packers left in, units not cleaned out
Exposed or wrong-colour screws; screw caps missing
Paint from the decorator on the joinery
Unit panel fitted before the access panel behind was fire-taped and photographed

ask.q: What gaps are you working to – door to door, and to the wall and ceiling?
ask.a: Equal all round to the EES/Molteni detail – they can give the figure. No visible scribe gaps.

ask.q: What are the units fixed into?
ask.a: Pattresses, photographed before boarding – not just plasterboard.

ask.q: Is the access panel behind fire-taped before the unit panel goes on?
Who checks for paint on the joinery after decoration?
ask.a: The joinery supervisor, before handover – paint and chips logged.
